page.overview:
Who is Caucasusman?

Caucasusman is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates' Armored Division. After being tamed by Tama, he became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

Caucasusman is a muscular man with a light brown hair. Due to consuming the Caucasus Beetle SMILE, he was an extra pair of arms, and the caucasus beetle horns protruding out of his head. He wears top hat with a skull with horns in the middle, a leather sleeveless jacket with a green collar, two pairs of light green gloves, beige pants with a belt and boots. On the back of his jacket is written .

Caucasusman appears to be loyal to the Beasts Pirates, and does not seem to have a problem with firing on Kouzuki Momonosuke, a child. He is also quite proud of being a Gifter, stating to Franky that they are not simple people and he cannot defeat them easily. In the anime, he appears to be cold-hearted, laughing alongside the rest of the Armored Division when Sasaki made fun of the Kouzuki Family.

As a Gifter, Caucasusman has eaten a SMILE|コーカサスオオカブトの|Kōkasasu Ōkabuto no Sumairu}}, giving him caucasus beetle horns protruding out of his head, and an extra pair of arms.
